title.zh: 特朗普是否会在2026年3月前对中国加征新关税？
title.en: Will Trump impose new tariffs on China before March 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年3月31日前，美国官方宣布对中国商品加征新一轮关税
yes.en: US officially announces new tariffs on Chinese goods before March 31, 2026

no.zh: 截止日期前无新关税公告
no.en: No new tariff announcement before the deadline

title.zh: 法国2026年议会选举，极右翼国民联盟能否获得多数席位？
title.en: Will France's National Rally win a majority in the 2026 parliamentary elections?

yes.zh: 国民联盟在2026年法国议会选举中获得超过289个席位
yes.en: National Rally wins more than 289 seats in the 2026 French parliamentary elections

no.zh: 国民联盟未能获得议会多数席位
no.en: National Rally fails to secure a parliamentary majority

title.zh: 乌克兰停火协议能否在2026年上半年达成？
title.en: Will a Ukraine ceasefire agreement be reached in the first half of 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年6月30日前，乌克兰与俄罗斯签署正式停火协议
yes.en: Ukraine and Russia sign a formal ceasefire agreement before June 30, 2026

no.zh: 截止日期前未达成正式停火协议
no.en: No formal ceasefire agreement reached before the deadline

title.zh: 以色列与哈马斯停火协议第二阶段能否顺利推进？
title.en: Will the second phase of the Israel-Hamas ceasefire proceed smoothly?

yes.zh: 2026年3月31日前，第二阶段谈判达成协议并开始执行
yes.en: Phase 2 negotiations reach an agreement and begin implementation before March 31, 2026

no.zh: 第二阶段谈判破裂或未能在截止日期前达成协议
no.en: Phase 2 negotiations collapse or fail to reach agreement before the deadline

title.zh: 德国新政府能否在2026年4月前完成组阁？
title.en: Will Germany's new government complete coalition formation before April 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年4月1日前，德国新联合政府正式宣誓就职
yes.en: Germany's new coalition government officially sworn in before April 1, 2026

no.zh: 组阁谈判延迟至4月之后

title.zh: 伊朗核谈判能否在2026年内取得实质性突破？
title.en: Will Iran nuclear talks achieve a substantive breakthrough in 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年12月31日前，伊朗与西方国家签署新核协议框架
yes.en: Iran and Western nations sign a new nuclear agreement framework before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 年内未达成任何实质性核协议
no.en: No substantive nuclear agreement reached within the year

title.zh: 菲律宾2026年中期选举，小马科斯阵营能否保住参议院多数？
title.en: Will Marcos Jr.'s bloc retain Senate majority in Philippines 2026 midterms?

yes.zh: 小马科斯支持的候选人在2026年菲律宾中期选举中赢得12个参议院席位中的7席或以上
yes.en: Marcos-backed candidates win 7 or more of the 12 Senate seats in the 2026 Philippine midterm elections

no.zh: 小马科斯阵营赢得少于7个参议院席位
no.en: Marcos bloc wins fewer than 7 Senate seats

title.zh: 台湾2026年地方选举，民进党能否守住主要县市？
title.en: Will Taiwan's DPP hold major counties in the 2026 local elections?

yes.zh: 民进党在2026年台湾地方选举中守住台北、新北、桃园三市中至少两席
yes.en: DPP retains at least 2 of Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan in the 2026 local elections

no.zh: 民进党在上述三市中仅保住一席或全部失守
no.en: DPP retains only 1 or none of the three cities

title.zh: 联合国安理会能否在2026年通过新的气候制裁决议？
title.en: Will the UN Security Council pass a new climate sanctions resolution in 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年12月31日前，联合国安理会通过具有约束力的气候相关制裁决议
yes.en: UN Security Council passes a binding climate-related sanctions resolution before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 年内未通过任何气候制裁决议
no.en: No climate sanctions resolution passed within the year

title.zh: 美国2026年中期选举，共和党能否保住众议院多数？
title.en: Will Republicans retain the House majority in the 2026 US midterm elections?

yes.zh: 共和党在2026年11月美国中期选举后仍控制众议院多数席位
yes.en: Republicans control a majority of House seats after the November 2026 US midterm elections

no.zh: 民主党赢得众议院多数席位
no.en: Democrats win a majority of House seats
